description: This file is a Node.js script written in JavaScript using ES Module syntax. It is designed to facilitate running batched tests on extensions via the Vitest testing framework, utilizing the 'child_process' module to spawn subprocesses, and managing command-line arguments to configure test runs.

methods.name: runVitestBatch
methods.description: Asynchronously spawns a child process to execute Vitest with provided parameters, handling process exit and errors.

methods.name: printUsage
methods.description: Outputs usage instructions for how to invoke this script.

methods.name: parseExtensionIds
methods.description: Parses raw command-line arguments to extract extension IDs and any remaining passthrough arguments.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main asynchronous function that orchestrates argument parsing, plan resolution, and batch test execution.
